conf/server_config_dev.json and default UI live hosts remain unchanged; fixture routing is opt-in and loopback-only.
Every current master...HEAD tracked file is represented in ordered_changes/planned_files, while .claude/, .gitnexus/, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md remain untouched user-owned files.

.gitignore has no final diff. webpack.make.js, Makefile and ui/style/monarch-ng.scss remain unchanged unless a declared command proves a direct upgraded-dependency failure; current active scripts/configuration require no edit to them.
The final diff is limited to planned files plus at most two authorized direct-call-site scope expansions and is committed as one execution commit.

rollback_strategy: Revert the single final execution commit created by the executor.
planning_notes: The ImpactReport is authoritative. This remediation plan reconciles all 32 files in the current master...HEAD diff and adds explicit test-only fixture/audit/portable-test work because no separate test-generation stage will run after execution. Current build/start results, smoke 3/3, lint, dependency tree and clean root/search/analyze console checks are accepted evidence but remain repeatable commands. Whole files package.json, webpack.config.js, the existing smoke test, server_config_dev.json and the small current diff hunks were inspected because cross-cutting script/proxy/module behavior could not be planned safely from isolated report ranges. Runtime-discovered compatibility files in the current diff are .npmrc, ui/.eslintrc, wbs.eslintrc, webapp_launcher.js, axios-worker.js, sync-http.js, the ES-module conversion files, Vue template fixes and ui/index.ejs; they are authoritative planned work, not speculative cleanup. tests/apitest.js and tests/phenopacket-test.js are explicit remediation scope expansions needed only to select the local config for the exact Makefile-equivalent Node tests. The new fixture, lifecycle, audit and contract-test files are explicit remediation scope expansions justified by final validation and are fully planned here. webpack.make.js is not referenced by package scripts and changing it would be speculative; Makefile is POSIX-only but its exact three Node targets are preserved through run-portable-tests.js; ui/style/monarch-ng.scss already compiles with Bootstrap 5/Dart Sass. Those three original planned-but-unchanged files are review-only/conditional and must remain unchanged unless a bounded declared command proves a direct failure, in which case the two-file scope-expansion budget applies. The fixture uses only loopback port 18080, production application ports remain 8080/8081, overrides default off, and cleanup is mandatory. External service state is never mutated. .claude/, .gitnexus/, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are user-owned exclusions; .gitignore must have no final diff.
plan_summary: Forty current and remediation changes preserve the completed Node 18/20 dependency/toolchain migration, reconcile every tracked diff file, and add an opt-in loopback fixture, portable direct tests, focused Axios audit assertion and bounded standard/USE_SPA browser validation. Production service URLs and fallback behavior remain unchanged; retired live-service failures are classified as external.
